why: All three checks confirm the finding. (1) The quote is VERBATIM at plugins.md:298, and reading the whole section rather than the one line strengthens it: :300 says "Setting `agent` activates one of the plugin's custom agents as the main thread, applying its system prompt, tool restrictions, and model", and :308 says "Settings from `settings.json` take priority over `settings` declared in `plugin.json`. Unknown keys are silently ignored." Nothing in the second half reverses the claim. (2) The cited state is accurate, with a 5-line citation drift: the row is at packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275, not :2270 (:2270 is a comment about `dependencies`). It reads exactly `{ externalKind: 'settings', field: 'settings', defaultPath: 'settings.json' }`, and addClaudeRetainedSurfaceDeferrals (:2278-2317, called at :270 with the bundle rootDirectory) fires on existsSync(<root>/settings.json), pushes `plugin.deferred.claude_settings` (reasonCode template at :2302) and, unlike the `themes` row, carries no `refusal` diagnostic, so the author is told nothing at install. `grep -ran subagentStatusLine` over the repo returns hits only inside docs/superpowers/specs/data/*.json (the sweep's own files) — zero source hits, confirmed with -a. (3) One layer up and one layer down both hold. Sibling-subsystem check: packages/shared/src/plugins/plugin-settings.ts also owns a file literally named settings.json, but it is the per-plugin data-path option store for MCPB user_config descriptors (the only producer of PluginSettingDescriptor is format-adapters/mcpb.ts:130) and has nothing to do with a Claude plugin-root file; claude.ts:2084's `'settings'` is a member of CLAUDE_UNREAD_LSP_FIELDS, an LSP server knob, a third unrelated `settings`. Consequence check, separate from the identifier: the fork has NO main-thread-agent override at all — no mechanism anywhere reads an agent name and installs it as the main thread — so nothing upstream honours the key by another route. The nearest live analogue, plugin-shipped output styles, IS honoured (capabilities/runtime-output-styles.ts, resolver.ts:612), which is the positive control proving plugin-shipped default-behaviour surfaces are otherwise wired; the settings.json path is the one that is not. Not one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (SEATBELT wildcard, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, listSessionSummaries) and not in the deviation register. Not a deliberate product difference either: importing Claude plugin bundles is a supported first-class surface of this fork, unrelated to the dropped subscription flows or the rebrand.
correctedState: Substantively confirmed, with two corrections. Citation: the row is at packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 (not :2270 — that line is a comment about `dependencies`). Consequence: 'silently does nothing' is right for a FIRST install but needs the nuance that the deferral is machine-readable. Shipping a plugin-root settings.json pushes `{ externalKind: 'settings', reasonCode: 'plugin.deferred.claude_settings' }` and flips compatibility.state to 'partial', but the install path (management-service-v2.ts:191-199) returns no requiresConfirmation, so describeInstallOutcome (useMarketplaceInstall.ts:54-72) reports neither blocked nor needsConfirmEnable, PluginsPage.tsx:291 never records the deferred list, and the user gets a plain success toast — no diagnostic, since only the `themes` row carries a `refusal`. A later update/repair DOES flip requiresConfirmation (management-service-v2.ts:572) and switches the plugin off pending confirm. Neither documented key is implemented: the `agent` key cannot be honoured because the fork has no main-thread-agent override at all, and `subagentStatusLine` has zero source hits repo-wide (the sibling `statusLine` surface is separately verdicted absent in the coverage map).
